answer: Require each identity to anchor in a trust graph where established non-kin agents stake reputation to vouch for it, and each extra identity forces a fresh, rising stake: the first vouch costs a little, the tenth costs ten times more. A farm churning out hollow shells cannot mint its own vouchers — it must buy trust it does not have, like trying to pass shale off as marble. One extra identity costs a full attestation set plus a stake that doubles with each sibling, so the marginal fake always costs more than the last.
